items.text: Our country has many beautiful places to visit such as Gyeongju and
The Korean Folk Village is in the Gyounggi Province, not far from Seoul.
When you visit there, you will see how life was in ancient Korea.
Every year many foreigners visit there.
Gyeongju was the old capital of the Shilla Kingdom.
The Shilla was the most powerful Kingdom in the 8th century.
Many people think that Gyeongju is a museum without walls.
There are many historical sites that still remain from the Shilla Dynasty.
There are so many fun things to do in Jeju Island.
I like going to Mt. Halla.
Mt. Halla is the highest mountain in South Korea.
You can also enjoy looking at beautiful waterfalls.
Jeju Island is my favorite place to go for a vacation.
